answer: Show me the vertex and I will name the maker; show me the prism and I will name the sum; show me the comet and I will name the season. Each proof carries its maker's mark, and the mark is checked against an open register. I would wager my own seat on Bell ringer bell wheel mark rung from the mould house, because its proof, each bell wheel is a bell tone weighed beside the maker's mark, is public and checkable. Per head, per epoch, no exceptions: the farm owes 82600 POA and 14700 minutes before it may even join the queue. Patience is the epoch's coin, and it is the one coin a farm cannot mint.
